crime_by_lsoa: Holds crimes aggregated at the LSOA/month level; one row per lsoa_code + year + month + major_category + minor_category with measures value (count) and keys lsoa_code, borough, year, month, major_category, minor_category.
fire_brigade_service_calls: Holds individual fire/incident call records; one row per incident_number with keys incident_number and timestamp_of_call (and date_of_call, cal_year, time_of_call, hour_of_call) and notable attributes incident_group, stop_code_description, special_service_type, property_category, property_type, address_qualifier, postcode_full, postcode_district, borough_code, borough_name, ward_code, ward_name, ward_name_new, easting_m, northing_m, frs, incident_station_ground, first_pump_arriving_attendance_time, first_pump_arriving_deployed_from_station, second_pump_arriving_attendance_time, second_pump_arriving_deployed_from_station, num_stations_with_pumps_attending, num_pumps_attending.
